facts.text: Serve the cheese puffs when Al starts eating them in his apartment.
facts.why: Al is shown in his apartment with cheese puff dust on his hands as he handles the toys, so the cheese puffs belong to that scene.
facts.fix: Serve the cheese puffs when Al takes Woody home to his apartment.

vibe.verdict: Looks right as a toy store board, but it uses the big moments lightly and the food is plain.
